2026-11-23.title: This week, your harvest comes in.
2026-11-23.text: As you give thanks this week, the Lord turns your gratitude into increase. Every field you sowed in tears yields its harvest, every delayed blessing arrives, and God, even your own God, blesses you and your household, in Jesus' name. Amen.
2026-11-23.verse: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

2026-11-24.verse: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits
lines: I will not forget the benefits of the Lord in my life this year.
Every sickness assigned against my body this season is healed by the Lord who forgives and heals.
My mouth is full of thanksgiving today, and my life is full of testimonies.

2026-11-25.verse: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
lines: The Lord has done great things for me, and greater things are coming.
Every captivity that held my joy this year is turned back today, in Jesus' name.
I sowed in tears, but I reap in joy before this year ends.

2026-11-26.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
lines: The mercy of God over my life and my family endures today and for ever.
On this Thanksgiving Day, every mouth speaking evil against my home is silenced.
I give thanks with my whole heart, and my table shall not lack.

2026-11-27.verse: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
lines: The Lord is my strength and my shield in every place I go today.
Because I trust in Him, I am helped; I will not be stranded.
My heart rejoices, and my song of praise rises above every trouble.

2026-11-28.verse: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
lines: The Lord crowns the rest of my year with His goodness.
Every path I walk this December drops fatness and favour.
No evil report will close my year; I finish with a crown, in Jesus' name.

2026-11-29.verse: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
lines: I serve the Lord with gladness today, and my worship is accepted.
Every heaviness on my spirit lifts as I come before His presence with singing.
I leave God's house today with joy, strength and a new testimony.
